gaussian_interval_coverage.conclusion: 67% is not exactly ±1σ and 95% is not exactly ±2σ. No plot provenance was inferred from this calculation.

0930_p3_source_gap_counterexample.construction: X,W,Z independent N(0,1); V=(1/2)W+sqrt(3)/2 Z; A=C=1, Q=R=1, H=Y=X+V, Xnext=X+W. Both W and V are independent of state X, as the source says. The source does not say W,V mutually independent.
0930_p3_source_gap_counterexample.calculation: Cov(Xnext,Y)=1+1/2=3/2 and Var(Y)=2, hence mean 3Y/4; conditional variance 2-(3/2)^2/2=7/8.
0930_p3_source_gap_counterexample.conclusion: Marginal state independence alone is insufficient; fresh-noise/conditional independence is substantive.
